title: Successor filtered cycles cover the page differential kernel
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex and $F$ a decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration]. Let $r\ge1$, let $D$ be differential data on the concrete quotient page [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential], and let $i=(p,q)$, $n=p+q$. Write $Z_s^{p,q}$ for the graded cycles [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. For the inclusion $h:Z_{r+1}^{p,q}\le Z_r^{p,q}$, there is an epimorphism $f:Z_{r+1}^{p,q}\to\ker(d_r^{p,q})$ such that its composite with the kernel inclusion equals the inclusion into $Z_r^{p,q}$ followed by the quotient projection into $Q_r^{p,q}$.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle, boundary and differential formulas and lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex

proof.text: Write n = p+q. The composite from Z_(r+1) into Z_r/B_r is killed by d_r: a representative has differential in F^(p+r+1), so its target graded class is zero. The representative equation for D proves this after pulling back the epimorphism from unquotiented representatives to graded cycles. Thus the composite factors uniquely through the kernel, giving f. To see that f is epic, locally lift a page cycle to an r-cycle representative x. Since its differential is an r-boundary in the target graded piece, after another epimorphic pullback write dx = dy modulo F^(p+r+1), with y in F^(p+1). Then x-y has the same source graded class and lies in the (r+1)-cycle representatives. These local lifts show that the image of f is the whole kernel. Pullbacks of epimorphisms remain epic in an abelian category, so this proves the assertion without projectivity assumptions.

theorem filteredComplex_successor_cycles_cover
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (D : FilteredComplexPageDifferential K F r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hZ : F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) ≤
      F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) r) :
    ∃ f : (F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) : C) ⟶ D.page.cycles pq,
      Epi f ∧ f ≫ D.page.iCycles pq =
        Subobject.ofLE _ _ hZ ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K F r pq
